findings.description: none: ProjectionKeyRequest, WorkSubmitRequest, and WorkReconcileRequest correctly enforce model_config extra='forbid' to reject undeclared top-level and nested fields, matching OpenAPI additionalProperties=false specifications.
findings.resolution: No action required; strict Pydantic extra-field policy correctly aligns HTTP endpoints with OpenAPI schemas.

findings.description: none: _projection_mutation_payload and the projection exception handlers ensure every service denial, policy violation, or guardrail failure returns an RFC 7807 application/problem+json 4xx response instead of an HTTP 200 failure envelope.
findings.resolution: No action required; error conversion cleanly prevents HTTP 200 success ambiguity.

findings.description: none: WorkSubmitRequest types depends_on as list[UUID] | None, guaranteeing malformed UUID strings are rejected at the FastAPI Pydantic validation boundary with HTTP 422.
findings.resolution: No action required; strong typing resolves the runtime ValueError vulnerability.

findings.description: Nit: test_projection_migration_declares_full_head_and_atomic_paths hardcodes a relative path from the workspace root, causing FileNotFoundError when pytest is executed inside agent-coordinator.
findings.resolution: Use Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'database/migrations/035_work_queue_projection.sql' to resolve the migration file relative to the test module.
